text:
maria gomez: FYI I tried enabling FP8 on H100 with transformer_engine v0.4 + our new kernel-mux. Seeing periodic stalls (~200-500ms) every few thousand tokens, usually around step 1.2k. Profiling attached in thread.

ajay singh: can you paste the repro command + env?

maria gomez: repro below — small opt server run:
```
TRANSFORMER_ENGINE=1 ENABLE_FP8=1 KERNEL_MUX=auto ./serve --model redwood-small --seq_len 4096 --micro_batch 4 --prefill 32
```

samir: ran that locally, saw kernel flip between `fmha_fp8_fastpath` and `fmha_stable_fp16` when batch sizes jittered. The switch correlates with a KV cache rehash event.

linh: interesting — we saw similar in L40S tests but different threshold. KV shrink/expand on prefill boundary triggers different occupancy estimates, which changes the kernel selector score.

maria gomez: profiler snapshot (summarized):
```
0. prefill: 18ms  (fp8_fastpath)
1. token 1200: 520ms (stall) -> kernel: fp8_fastpath -> fallback to fp16 slowpath
2. token 1201: 20ms (fp16)
```

devon: that 520ms looks like memory compaction / kernel launch spin. Could be a large KV eviction + cudamalloc churn when bucket resized. Does `nvprof` show OOM retries?

maria gomez: no OOM. But `cudaMalloc` time spikes. Also see many small memcpy spikes from KV eviction callbacks.

ajay singh: hypothesis: probabilistic calibration we added changes scale factors slightly on warmup, which makes fp8 kernel think quant ranges are out-of-bound and triggers a safe fallback path. Two levers: (1) enforce deterministic calib on warmup, (2) bias kernel mux to avoid flip for N warm tokens.

samir: patch idea: add mux hysteresis window of 256 tokens and treat KV-resize events as a soft penalty in selector score. Quick pseudo: `if last_kernel != candidate && token_since_switch < HYSTERESIS -> prefer last_kernel`

linh: also try `TRANSFORMER_ENGINE_FORCE_FP8_SCALE=1e-3` to stabilize quant scale updates (temp). Worth a canary.

maria gomez: will run canary with `HYSTERESIS=256` + stable-scale env tomorrow morning. Can someone run a stress test on L40S to compare? @samir @devon :eyes:

devon: I can run a 12h churn on both H100/L40S on dedicated infra. Will add tracepoints for kernel choice, KV resize, cudaMalloc stalls.

ops-bot: deploy started: canary/h100-fp8-prob-calib (1/10 instances)

ajay singh: if canary looks good, follow-up items: record perf regression PR (likely introduced by selector heuristics commit `a1f3b2c`), add unit test mocking KV-growth event, and add trace metric `kernel_mux_flips_per_1k_tokens` to Console.

maria gomez: thanks. Also adding a short eval to check token-level perplexity drift with forced-stable-calib vs probabilistic. We saw a tiny BLEU-ish drop in dev earlier when calibration jittered.

samir: sounds good. One more note: consider gating fallback to fp16 to only happen when accumulated overflow_count > 2 in last 512 tokens, not immediate. That should reduce thrash.

maria gomez: agreed. Will update the PR with hysteresis + fallback gating. Posting perf logs after the canary run. :thumbsup:
